units.source_text: 明石女御对义母紫姬，比对生母明石姬更加亲昵而信赖。

en.t: Lady Akashi was closer to and trusted her adoptive mother, Lady Murasaki, more than her birth mother, Lady Akashi.

units.source_text: 紫姬对这个成长得十分美丽的义女，也真心地疼爱。

en.t: Lady Murasaki, too, sincerely loved this adopted daughter who had grown into such a beautiful young woman.

units.source_text: 紫姬和明石女御亲切地谈了一会之后，便叫人打开界门，去和三公主会面。

en.t: After speaking warmly for a while with Lady Akashi, Lady Murasaki had someone open the partition gate and went to meet the Third Princess.

units.source_text: 她看了三公主那天真烂漫的孩童模样，觉得很安心，便用母亲一般长辈的口气，和她叙述彼此之间的血统关系。

en.t: Seeing the Third Princess's innocent, childlike manner, she felt reassured and, in the tone of a motherly elder, explained the blood relationship between them.

units.source_text: 又召唤乳母中纳言来前，对她说道：“恕我不揣冒昧：论起血统来，我们是姑表姐妹呢。

en.t: She also summoned the nurse Chuunagon and said to her, "Forgive my boldness, but by blood we are cousins through our fathers' family.

units.source_text: 只因没有机会，彼此尚未见面。

en.t: Only because there was no opportunity have we not met each other until now.

units.source_text: 自今以后，应该多多亲近了。

en.t: From now on, we should become much closer.

units.source_text: 你们也常到我那边去坐坐。

en.t: You should also come often and sit with me at my place.

units.source_text: 如果我有怠慢之处，务请随时指示，我就不胜欣幸了。”

en.t: If I am ever neglectful in any way, please tell me at once; I would be most grateful."

units.source_text: 中纳言答道：“我家公主早岁丧母，最近上皇又遁入空门，无怙无恃，孤苦伶仃。

en.t: Chuunagon replied, "Our princess lost her mother when she was young, and recently the retired emperor also entered religious life, leaving her helpless and alone.

units.source_text: 今蒙夫人如此嘉许，真乃无上幸福。

en.t: To receive such kind approval from you now is truly the greatest happiness.

units.source_text: 出家的上皇亦曾如此企望：但愿夫人推诚相爱，多多照拂这位幼稚无知的公主。

en.t: The retired emperor who has taken vows also hoped for this: that you would love her with sincerity and look after this young and innocent princess with great care.

units.source_text: 公主自心亦极愿依附夫人也。”

en.t: The princess herself also very much wishes to rely on you."

units.source_text: 紫姬说道：“辱承上皇赐书之后，常思尽力为公主效劳。

en.t: Lady Murasaki said, "Ever since I was honored with a letter from the retired emperor, I have always wished to do all I could for the princess.

units.source_text: 但恨我身无才无德，微不足数，辜负盛情，不胜愧憾耳。”

en.t: But I regret that I have neither talent nor virtue and am of little worth; I feel deeply ashamed that I cannot answer such generous feelings."

units.source_text: 她就解除一切顾虑，像大姐对小妹一般，闲谈三公主所爱听的话，

en.t: Then she set aside all reserve and, like an elder sister with a younger one, chatted casually about things the Third Princess liked to hear,

units.source_text: 例如关于图画欣赏、关于玩偶游戏的难忘的乐趣，谈得像孩子们一般兴高采烈。

en.t: such as enjoying pictures and the unforgettable pleasures of playing with dolls, speaking with the same excitement as children.

units.source_text: 三公主觉得果如源氏所说，此人还有孩子脾气，她的童心便亲切地倾慕她了。

en.t: The Third Princess felt that, just as Genji had said, this lady still had a childlike nature, and her own childish heart grew warmly fond of her.

units.source_text: 自此以后，两人常常通信，凡是富有趣味的游戏，总是两人共同欣赏。

en.t: After that, the two often exchanged letters, and whenever there was an amusing game, they always enjoyed it together.

units.source_text: 关于这高贵人家之事，世人都喜欢凭空说长道短。

en.t: When it came to the affairs of this noble household, people in the world loved to gossip without any basis.

units.source_text: 三公主初进六条院时，有人说道：“不知紫夫人作何感想。

en.t: When the Third Princess first entered the Rokujo estate, some people said, "I wonder how Lady Murasaki feels about this.

units.source_text: 源氏对她的宠爱一定不及从前了，总要冷淡些吧。”

en.t: Genji's affection for her surely cannot be what it once was; he must become somewhat colder toward her."

units.source_text: 实则三公主进来之后，源氏对紫姬的宠爱反而更深了些。

en.t: In fact, after the Third Princess came, Genji's affection for Lady Murasaki grew even deeper.

units.source_text: 世人还要妄加猜测，说些不妙的话。

en.t: Still, people continued to make reckless guesses and say unpleasant things.

units.source_text: 但因紫姬与三公主两人如此和好相处，故外间谣言终于平息，源氏家声也保全了。

en.t: But because Lady Murasaki and the Third Princess got along so well, the rumors outside finally died down, and Genji's family reputation was preserved.
